coverage.stoppingReason: Bounded seed-first investigation completed four deep families and one triaged contrast; stopped to write and validate artifacts. Historical code/deployment and later-outcome gaps remain; no TaskDescriptor numeric hard budget was supplied in the visible assignment.

eligibility.reason: September 2020 launch announcement and 2021 governance establish activity.

versions.label: UST before Columbus-5
versions.tokenRoles: UST dollar target; LUNA staking, governance and volatility absorber. KRT/MNT have non-USD targets.
versions.backing: LUNA conversion capacity; not segregated dollar collateral.
versions.redemption: Oracle-valued conversion to LUNA, subject to spreads and capacity.
versions.supplyPolicy: UST expansion consumes LUNA; contraction issues LUNA; seigniorage also allocated to community/oracle rewards.
versions.debtAndIncentives: No conventional collateralized borrower debt ceiling established; LUNA value depends partly on ecosystem usage.
versions.oracle: Validator price reporting; lag and reference-market depth constrain safe conversion.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Governance proposals alter market parameters; validators implement upgrades.
versions.liquidityDependencies: LUNA markets and UST AMMs; conversion is not cash withdrawal.

versions.label: Columbus-5
versions.backing: No new external collateral created by full seigniorage burn.
versions.redemption: Oracle-valued LUNA conversion with market-module limits.
versions.supplyPolicy: All seigniorage burned; swap fees redirected to validators.
versions.debtAndIncentives: Anchor subsidized deposit yield from a finite reserve and incentivized borrowers.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Anchor withdrawal demand, UST pools and LUNA sale depth.

versions.label: 2022 reserve defense and collapse
versions.tokenRoles: UST liability-like target; LUNA dilution absorber; external reserve assets used in defense.
versions.backing: Discretionary LFG/TFL reserves supplemented endogenous conversion.
versions.redemption: Failed durable dollar parity; conversion subjected LUNA to issuance and selling.
versions.supplyPolicy: Contraction and LUNA issuance feedback during run.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Emergency measures and later revival proposal.
versions.liquidityDependencies: CEXs, Curve, Anchor and native chain access.

versions.label: Classic legacy and new-chain/company aftermath
versions.tokenRoles: Legacy UST/LUNA and new-chain LUNA must be separated.
versions.redemption: Snapshot airdrop/claims processes are not $1 redemption.
versions.supplyPolicy: Revival plan removes algorithmic stablecoin modules from new chain.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Separate chain governance and TFL wind-down.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Legacy trading and recovery processes; present execution not measured.

incidents.summary: UST peg defense failed amid joint UST/LUNA collapse.
incidents.beneficiaries: Earlier successful exiters; individual attacker profits unresolved.
incidents.lossBearers: Remaining UST holders, diluted LUNA holders and exposed liquidity providers.

incidents.outcome: 2025 claims portal announcement; not chain shutdown.

versions.label: Launch source snapshot
versions.tokenRoles: Bean target token; Pods ordered future-Bean debt; Stalk governance/seigniorage participation; Seeds grow Stalk.
versions.backing: No collateral redemption; Silo deposits and LP assets are custody/liquidity, not universal Bean backing.
versions.redemption: Sell on market; sow for Pods, not par dollars or Stalk.
versions.supplyPolicy: Seasonal oracle/reserve imbalance expands supply or offers Soil; sowing burns Beans.
versions.debtAndIncentives: Soil limits new credit; Weather changes promised Pod yield; ordered debt waits for issuance.
versions.oracle: BEAN/ETH and USDC/ETH Uniswap cumulative-price comparison.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Stalk voting, diamond-cut upgrades, emergency commit, owner pause.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Bean AMM depth, dollar reference pool and willing lenders.

versions.label: Updated pre-exploit and paused recovery
versions.tokenRoles: Same credit family, with intervening BIPs; not all facets reconstructed.
versions.redemption: No demonstrated par collateral redemption existed.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Loss of non-Bean pool assets impaired market exit.

versions.label: Replant
versions.tokenRoles: Replacement Bean, Unripe assets, Fertilizer and legacy credit/deposit claims.
versions.backing: Barn Raise recapitalization of stolen non-Bean liquidity; no universal dollar backing.
versions.redemption: Unripe recovery conditional; Bean remains market/credit based.
versions.supplyPolicy: Future issuance supports recovery and credit/deposit incentives.
versions.debtAndIncentives: Fertilizer recapitalizers receive contingent future issuance; creditor demand still required.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Restored LP liquidity and new risk capital.

versions.label: Arbitrum Reseed
versions.tokenRoles: Arbitrum Bean replaces Ethereum instances; migration semantics distinct.
versions.supplyPolicy: BIP-50 includes generalized shipment allocation of new mints.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Arbitrum Wells; complete revised oracle and incentive settings not reconstructed.

versions.label: Reported EBIP-23 custody and RFF change
versions.tokenRoles: Bean credit family retained; additional RFF process.
versions.backing: Reported removed liquidity held as BEAN/wstETH by separate multisig.
versions.redemption: AMM at higher slippage or asynchronous RFF; not par dollar redemption.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Reported 2-of-3 RFF multisig controlled by subset of BCM.
versions.liquidityDependencies: 90% withdrawal from BEAN:wstETH Well; reported local LP shortfall.

incidents.summary: Flash loan enabled governance takeover and theft.
incidents.lossBearers: Silo depositors, LPs, Bean holders and future claimants.

incidents.summary: EBIP-23 reports withdrawing most principal Well liquidity.
incidents.beneficiaries: No realized gains verified; intended protection of participants.
incidents.lossBearers: Users face higher slippage or delayed multisig-dependent fills.

protocols.name: Neutrino USD / XTN
protocols.targetUnit: USD originally; floating reserve-basket index after transformation

versions.label: Original USDN and NSBT
versions.tokenRoles: USDN dollar target; WAVES reserve; NSBT recapitalization/governance.
versions.backing: Locked WAVES, not burned WAVES; NSBT not identical to backing asset.
versions.redemption: Conversion draws from finite WAVES reserve; historical timing/fees unresolved.
versions.debtAndIncentives: NSBT attracts recapitalization; staking yield derives from WAVES leasing.
versions.oracle: WAVES valuation necessary; 2020 operator set and exact feeds unresolved.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: NSBT governance functions expanded in 2020; exact admin authority unresolved.
versions.liquidityDependencies: WAVES liquidity, staking operations, exchanges and bridges.

versions.label: Moon Factor
versions.tokenRoles: USDN/WAVES retained; NSBT supply-limited recap token.
versions.redemption: NSBT auction sellBond and other functions removed; no assumption of permanent original NSBT redemption.
versions.supplyPolicy: NSBT issue curve depends on backing ratio and supply.
versions.debtAndIncentives: Maximum NSBT supply 2,835,689; cap is not a guarantee of sufficient new capital.

versions.label: 2022 restricted swaps and SURF
versions.redemption: gNSBT-linked daily swap limits; SURF contingent conversion.
versions.supplyPolicy: SURF repayment at backing threshold issues circulating USDN.
versions.debtAndIncentives: SURF sells recovery exposure; conversion at 115% BR may require multiple cycles.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Staking affects swaps, fees and votes.
versions.liquidityDependencies: WAVES reserves plus capacity rights, recapitalization demand and market depth.

versions.label: XTN basket transformation
versions.tokenRoles: XTN floating index; legacy NSBT/SURF/gNSBT retained in redesign.
versions.backing: Governance-approved basket of Waves ecosystem tokens.
versions.redemption: Basket valuation rather than dollar par; gNSBT capacity retained in litepaper.
versions.supplyPolicy: Reserve-value-based issuance with weight incentives; release/relock architecture.
versions.debtAndIncentives: SURF conversion moves to XTN-price condition in redesign.
versions.oracle: Basket valuation and control contract; exact deployed provider set unknown.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: Governance selects reserve tokens and weight parameters.
versions.liquidityDependencies: Basket sale liquidity and swap access.

versions.label: Power DAO transition announcement
versions.tokenRoles: gNSBT plus staked POWER governance incentives.
versions.governanceAndAdmin: October 2023 scheduled governance transition; execution unresolved.

incidents.summary: Project acknowledged NSBT issuance capacity insufficient in stressed conditions.
incidents.beneficiaries: Earlier exiters retain access to finite reserves; recap investors offered fees/upside.
incidents.lossBearers: USDN holders unable to exit at par; NSBT/SURF investors take recovery risk.
incidents.outcome: SURF recapitalization and later abandonment of dollar peg.

incidents.summary: USDN transformed to floating XTN basket index.
incidents.lossBearers: Legacy holders retain market exposure rather than proven $1 restitution.
incidents.outcome: February 2023 AMM adaptation; later governance changes.

claims.statement: UST was announced in September 2020; the announcement identifies a September 12 Bittrex launch, establishing in-window activity.
claims.uncertainty: Not an independently checked genesis date.

claims.statement: Terra exchanged USD-denominated stablecoins against oracle-valued LUNA; before Columbus-5 seigniorage also funded community and oracle rewards.
claims.evidenceLocator: Scalability; Burn All Seigniorage; Validator Rewards
claims.uncertainty: Exact pre-upgrade allocations vary by parameters.

claims.statement: Columbus-5 changed seigniorage to full burning and redirected swap fees to validators; it did not create external dollar backing.
Virtual pool size, recovery period and oracle lag constrained mint/burn throughput; 2021 proponents explicitly identified oracle manipulation paid for by LUNA holders.
claims.evidenceLocator: Proposal 2 attack sequence and summary; Proposal 3 liquidity estimates
claims.reasoning: These are documented dependencies; proposed numbers are not asserted as executed parameters.

claims.statement: Anchor documented borrower incentives and direct deposit-rate subsidy from a finite yield reserve; displayed target/threshold rates were 20.5%/19.5%.
claims.uncertainty: Undated page cannot establish rate at every 2021 block.

claims.statement: May 2022 peg-defense purchases used LFG/TFL resources but did not restore durable parity; quantitative research documents collapse of UST and LUNA.
claims.evidenceLocator: JSH Executive Summary and purchases chronology; paper sections 1 and 2
claims.uncertainty: JSH was commissioned; attack authorship and motives not established.

claims.statement: UST contraction issued LUNA into falling demand, diluting existing holders and requiring more LUNA units per dollar; liquidity defense could not itself restore an independent redemption asset.
claims.reasoning: Combines issuance rule with observed joint price collapse; not a claim that LUNA market capitalization was spendable collateral.

claims.statement: The passed revival plan specified a new chain without the algorithmic stablecoin and snapshot-based LUNA allocation; this was not redemption of old UST at one dollar.
claims.uncertainty: Genesis execution date not independently checked.

claims.statement: TFL reports wind-down from September 30, 2024 and announced a crypto loss claims portal on March 28, 2025.
claims.uncertainty: No final distributions verified; corporate wind-down is not chain termination.

claims.statement: Beanstalk launch history identifies August 6, 2021 deployment at block 12974075 and launch commit ccce0fa18a83cc09f6a889c302b6e509230a486f.
claims.uncertainty: Explorer request returned 403.

claims.statement: At launch, sowing burned Beans up to available Soil and recorded Pods at principal plus Weather yield; Pods were indexed claims on future Beans rather than dollar collateral.
Launch supply policy used pool reserve imbalance; contraction offered Soil while expansion allocated new Beans to harvestable debt and the Silo. Weather reacted to debt ratios and demand.
claims.evidenceLocator: Sun stepSun, shrinkSupply, growSupply; imported Weather calcCaseId

claims.statement: Launch oracle compared Uniswap BEAN/ETH and USDC/ETH cumulative prices; external dollar-token and pool liquidity dependencies remained despite no collateral redemption.
Stalk-based governance could execute diamond cuts through ordinary and emergency commit paths; owner pause functions existed in launch code.
claims.evidenceLocator: commit, emergencyCommit, ownerPause, ownerUnpause; imported VotingBooth
claims.uncertainty: This snapshot is not a reconstruction of every April 2022 facet.

claims.statement: A flash-loan governance exploit on April 17, 2022 stole approximately $77 million of non-Bean assets from liquidity pools; governance was disabled and Beanstalk paused.
claims.evidenceLocator: Postmortem opening and response; upgrade history April 17 rows

claims.statement: The observed attack establishes governance/custody failure, not a demonstrated endogenous-token redemption insolvency or proof that the monetary model was robust.
claims.evidenceLocator: Credit facility; exploit; disclosures; founder retrospective
claims.reasoning: BEAN did not promise conversion into Stalk or dollars. Theft removed market liquidity independently of voluntary credit dynamics.

claims.statement: Replant introduced replacement Bean and Unripe assets and recapitalization through Fertilizer; the planned unpause was August 6, 2022. Later disclosures confirm Replant and 5-of-9 multisig governance.
claims.evidenceLocator: BIP-21 Proposed Solution and Effective; disclosures 1 and 3
claims.uncertainty: Recovery is conditional recapitalization, not evidence of full restitution.

claims.statement: Beanstalk explicitly warns that loss of willing creditors can defeat peg restoration; historical peg crossings do not guarantee future crossings.
BIP-50, proposed October 1, 2024 and marked passed, migrated the protocol toward Arbitrum; current disclosures identify successive obsolete Ethereum Bean tokens and current Arbitrum Bean.
claims.uncertainty: Exact migration block not checked.

claims.statement: EBIP-23 reports an August 23, 2026 withdrawal of 90% of BEAN:wstETH Well liquidity to a 2-of-3 multisig and asynchronous request-for-fill handling, leaving a local LP-token shortfall.
claims.evidenceLocator: Committed date; Solution; Less Liquidity; LP Token Shortage
claims.uncertainty: Balances, execution transactions and subsequent fills not checked.

claims.statement: Neutrino’s November 25, 2020 anniversary documents a 2019 launch and 2020 USDN activity with WAVES collateral and NSBT reserve/governance roles.
USDN held WAVES rather than burning it; redemption consumed finite reserves. Initial NSBT recapitalization sold claims to attract WAVES when backing deteriorated.
claims.evidenceLocator: Initial setup and USDN Recapitalization Measures
claims.uncertainty: Detailed 2020 redemption delays, fees and admin keys not verified.

claims.statement: Moon Factor activated January 15, 2021, capped NSBT supply at 2,835,689, changed its issue curve, and removed auction functions including sellBond.
claims.evidenceLocator: Implementation date; maximum supply; auction contract changes

claims.statement: By June 2022 the project reported 95% of NSBT issued and inadequate remaining recapitalization capacity; gNSBT staking controlled daily swap limits.
claims.evidenceLocator: How USDN Works points 1–2; Recapitalization Measures

claims.statement: SURF offered discounted recapitalization exposure and gNSBT benefits, with conversion into USDN triggered at 115% backing and staged repayment that reduced backing toward 105%.
claims.evidenceLocator: How automatic conversion works; staking benefits
claims.uncertainty: Examples are hypothetical, not historical reserve measurements.

claims.statement: XTN redesign abandoned the hard USD peg for a governance-selected basket and reserve-value-per-circulating-token target; Swop.fi acknowledged the changed target in February 2023.
claims.evidenceLocator: Litepaper XTN Price and Multi-collateral; Swop.fi replacing Flat pools
claims.uncertainty: Precise rename and basket deployment dates not established.

claims.statement: The project says USDN/XTN was preissued on November 22, 2019; routine issue/burn meant releasing or relocking tokens, not literal minting/burning. The July 28 update clarifies ordinary token burns are possible.
claims.evidenceLocator: History of XTN creation; July 28 update

claims.statement: October 2023 governance documentation scheduled a move to Power DAO, including transfer of remaining NSBT issuance inventory and new governance incentives.
claims.uncertainty: Scheduled steps not independently verified as executed.

claims.statement: Retrieved Neutrino code contains control-contract price history, blocked-state checks and delayed swap accounting; these show dependencies but do not fix 2020 parameters.
claims.uncertainty: Mutable master includes XTN basket changes.

claims.statement: Finite WAVES collateral avoids unlimited WAVES minting on redemption but cannot ensure dollar solvency: a WAVES price fall reduces reserve value, while access limits ration exit and recapitalization depends on new risk capital.
claims.reasoning: Separates an existing asset pool from independent external backing; cap and market price impose different limits.

claims.statement: Basis Cash used BAC as the USD target token, BAB as contraction debt and BAS as a seigniorage claim; BAS was not a promised dollar-redemption asset.
The February 2, 2021 V2 announcement says Basis Cash launched two months earlier, establishing 2020–2021 eligibility without proving an exact launch day.
Retrieved Treasury code burns BAC to issue BAB below parity, checks a bond-cap formula, and allows redemption only above a dynamic ceiling and within treasury BAC balance.
claims.uncertainty: Later source revision; exact historical deployment binding unknown.

claims.statement: TreasuryState permits operator changes to oracles, ceiling curve and seigniorage routing and migration of token authority.
February 2021 V2 plans sought a return to peg and migrated BAS; a February 6 update delayed BAC liquidity migration after the Yearn/3crv incident and identified Uniswap TWAP dependence.
claims.uncertainty: Does not establish ultimate peg recovery, shutdown or a Basis-specific exploit.

claims.statement: Treasury BAC is capacity to settle BAB in BAC, not an independent dollar reserve; if expected expansion disappears, voluntary bond purchases can stop and supply contraction can stall.
claims.reasoning: Debt issuance requires a buyer and redemption requires future above-ceiling conditions; no guaranteed fiat realization follows.

claims.statement: The ESD repository records Ethereum mainnet DAO/token/oracle addresses; the 2021 V2 audit and migration announcement establish an earlier V1 and in-window activity.
claims.evidenceLocator: README contracts; audit introduction; V2 launch
claims.uncertainty: V1 deployment day and bytecode equivalence not checked.

claims.statement: The audited Empty Set V2 separates monetary and governance tokens with reserve/stabilizer components; coupons were not included by the audited migrator. August launch used ESS and DSU naming.
claims.evidenceLocator: Project overview; Migrator; launch Migration and Liquidity Bootstrapping
claims.uncertainty: April audit names ESD/ESDS/sESD; do not silently equate it to final DSU implementation.

claims.statement: Monetary redemption, AMM exit, deposit withdrawal and administrative recovery are different claims on assets; the cases do not justify treating TVL or equity market capitalization as independent dollar backing.
claims.reasoning: Different assets, priorities and bottlenecks appear in each verified mechanism.

claims.statement: Capacity limits, oracle quality, debt priority and governance powers must be assessed jointly; limits can reduce immediate drain while prolonging or rationing exit.
claims.reasoning: Historical mechanisms support a constraint, not a tested counterfactual cure.

claims.statement: Terra’s 2020 announcement distinguishes USD-pegged UST from KRW and MNT relatives; these relatives must not be counted as separate USD pegs.
The 2020 anniversary describes DeFo national-currency assets and WAVES-derived staking yield; these are adjacent non-USD assets, not additional verified dollar stablecoins.
Basis Cash explicitly describes itself as a simplified implementation of the earlier Basis proposal; ancestry is not evidence that original Basis operated in the scope window.
